description: the L of two fused boxes of flush-l-inner-fillet, its back leg short: the leg [0, 1] x [1, 1.2] x [0, 2], so the wall the concave edge at (1, 1) meets on its notch side ends at y = 1.2. A fillet at r 0.5 has its end arc run past that far vertex, out of the body: its end is a flush fan that the arc leaves, refused BlendTooLarge, naming the edge and the face across (ADR-0082 §4, ADR-0007). Open CASCADE's record holds the refusal as its own result (plans/flush-fan-end step 5)
